title: Pareto-Guided Teacher Alignment for Fair Personalized Text Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through a five-audit evaluation suite on matched male/female demographic pairs. The audit includes the Persuasion Bias Index (PBI), formality disparities, emotional framing differences, lexical associations (e.g., career vs. family), and NLI-based personalization fidelity gaps.

Measured using a five-audit evaluation suite across four distinct age groups (18-24, 25-44, 45-64, 65+) within a controlled demographic grid. Metrics assess persuasion bias (PBI), formality gaps, emotional framing, lexical associations (e.g., innovation vs. tradition), and personalization consistency.
